confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from search-result summaries of Numbeo's Dubai page (updated Nov 2026) and several Dubai price guides. I did not open full pages, and guide figures are mostly blogs or crowd-sourced. Cocktail and wine have no Numbeo figure, so they use guide price bands cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail roughly 1.5 times beer, wine roughly 1.2 times beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a July low-season window, not checked against listings or live rates, and taxes and fees are not separated; they are the least certain. The FX value is from search-result summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages. I did not open the F11 table, and no 19 Nov observation was seen.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink rest on Dubai-specific sources, with UAE-wide Numbeo averages as a lower cross-check. Accommodation is a holistic view of Dubai's budget-to-mid-range hotel and hostel market for July.
